verdict.rationale: Thoropass's dashboard and Monitors page show control counts, ownership, and audit-readiness signals (e.g., 'Total Controls', 'Controls with Owners', flagged issues, and a Monitors page that lets you 'assess system health... and manage your audit readiness'), and the Compliance Roadmap lets you filter/group controls by framework and status. However, none of the evidence describes a single, honest aggregated readiness percentage per framework combining passing/gaps/remaining into one score — the documented dashboard exposes counts and flags, not a unified percentage metric. Missing for 10: explicit per-framework readiness percentage, documented gap-to-total ratio calculation, and evidence of an at-a-glance 'X% audit-ready' indicator.
